themes.theme: Value and Rationale of Modern Language Study
themes.reason: This is the sole theme in the extract and it directly states why the government has chosen to intervene with this content specification: modern languages provide cognitive, academic, and transferable skill benefits valued by individuals, society, higher education, and employers, and the content is designed to serve all students regardless of future path. This is the foundational rationale for the proposal; without it there is no justification given for the intervention.
